scope: Recorded daily agent calls, including retries and the ship call once it finishes. Excludes maintenance, CLI metadata/title calls, unreported child sessions, CI, and rendering. The frozen tutorial is a snapshot from before the ship call completes.
note: OpenCode Go dollars describe reported usage or an estimated draw against plan allowances, not an additional per-run invoice. Missing usage is unknown, never zero. Estimates use dated rates; subscription fees are not allocated to individual runs.
